question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**little**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage is describing a brief period during which the events occurred.
 
• The adjective should effectively indicate the length of time that passed.
 
• "**Little**" fits well as it is commonly used to describe a brief duration of time in a more informal or casual context.
 
• Other options ("**petty**", "**small**", "**short**") do not fit as naturally in the context of describing a brief period of time in this passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.
